mintAuthority.summary: REUR is issued by RIB Digital Holdings (Hong Kong) via non-upgradeable token contracts on three chains. On Ethereum and BSC the MASTERMINTER and DEFAULT_ADMIN is EOA 0xc50ebe57; on Tron the MASTERMINTER is a separate EOA (0x9a0c5f3a in EVM notation). The MASTERMINTER can call mintByMaster() directly or configureMinter() to authorize sub-minters; no active sub-minters were found at review time.

controls.label: RIB Digital issuance EOA — Ethereum and BSC (MASTERMINTER + DEFAULT_ADMIN)
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25295037, owner() on 0x3ed0b3c4c0168a560d34e361b8130dcca4677736 returned 0xc50ebe57ae937a8ac0bcaab8945777c3be54a511; eth_getCode = 0x (EOA). hasRole(DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE, 0xc50ebe57) = true; hasRole(MASTERMINTER_ROLE, 0xc50ebe57) = true. Neither the proxy-admin slot nor the EIP-1967 impl slot is set (contract is not upgradeable). BSC: owner() same address confirmed at BSC block 103629529. isMinter(owner) = false (no sub-minter configured); mintByMaster() is available directly to the MASTERMINTER.

controls.label: RIB Digital issuance EOA — Tron (MASTERMINTER + DEFAULT_ADMIN)
controls.evidence: On Tron, owner() on TXUi9vL8Ltz4dVpC6RM8CdtKSTHxFZuFbz (EVM 0xebef0a34) returned 0x9a0c5f3a73fafb8bd7e7c4c8295cdd8daa87f692; eth_getCode via Tron JSONRPC = 0x (EOA). hasRole(MASTERMINTER_ROLE, 0x9a0c5f3a) = true. Different EOA from ETH/BSC but same concentrated-admin pattern.

review.evidence: Ethereum block 25295037: owner = DEFAULT_ADMIN = MASTERMINTER = 0xc50ebe57 (EOA), not upgradeable, no sub-minters configured. BSC block 103629529: same owner confirmed. Tron (TXUi9vL8Ltz4dVpC6RM8CdtKSTHxFZuFbz): MASTERMINTER = 0x9a0c5f3a (EOA). All on-chain mint surfaces resolved across all deployed chains. REUR proof-of-reserves is issuer-self-published (RIB Digital-signed snapshots, self-verification, no liability reconciliation) with no named independent accounting firm, so reconciliation is unknown. The only verifiable banking licence in the Royal-branded group (Labuan FSA investment-bank licence 220147BI) belongs to a separate Malaysian entity, The Royal Investment Bank of Kelantan, not the Hong Kong REUR issuer RIB Digital Holdings Limited, and no regulator supervising the actual issuer was found, so supervision is none. Economic-posture fields reviewed 2026-08-15: direct issuer EOAs can mint without a firm cap, while self-verified assets-only snapshots leave reconciliation unknown and no issuer supervisor is evidenced.
